name: Lovable
desc: Chat-driven builder for full-stack React web apps
desc_zh: 对话式全栈 React 应用生成器，上线半年成为最快增长的 AI 应用
solves: A working web app needs a frontend, a backend and a database before you can show anyone. Lovable writes all three from a chat.
solves_zh: 一个能跑起来的 Web 应用要前端、后端和数据库才能给人看。Lovable 通过对话把三样都写出来。
best_for: When you want a working prototype this week without hiring anyone.
best_for_zh: 当你这周就要一个可用的原型，又不打算招人。
